# ColorfulAnvil
Minecraft plugin for Paper and forks with [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/) support that allows [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/) to be used in anvils and the chat!

## Usage
Rename items in an anvil or send a chat using the [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/) format. Generators exist for convenience such as [advntr.dev](https://webui.advntr.dev/) or [Birdflop](https://www.birdflop.com/resources/rgb/).
